# Policy Comparison Results (RQ3)

Four serve/hold policies on paired seeds (identical arrivals for every policy at a given scenario and seed):

- **baseline-fifo**: always serve, within-class order = queue insertion order (a deferred item re-enters at the back of its class).
- **baseline-edf**: always serve, within-class order = earliest deadline first. This is the repo's BASELINE_POLICY; sim/driver.py applies EDF to every policy, so the previously reported "baseline" was already this one.
- **lookahead** (code: OraclePolicy, formerly called "oracle"): rolls the simulator forward 900 s under serve and under hold, with a serve-when-possible EDF tail, and picks the better lexicographic score. A heuristic, not an upper bound.
- **tree**: CART, Gini splits, max depth 4, min 5 samples per leaf, trained per scenario on the lookahead policy's (features, action) pairs from both configs.

Seeds: training 1000-1019 (20 seeds); evaluation 6000, 6001, 6002, 6003, 6004, 6005, 6006, 6007, 6008, 6009, 6010, 6011, 6012, 6013, 6014, 6015, 6016, 6017, 6018, 6019 (20 seeds; disjoint from training). Seed 42 (the paper's single-seed run) is shown in the per-seed tables but excluded from the means. Duration 172800 s, dt 10 s.

Metrics: window delivery = delivered by end of run / generated; deadline success = delivered at a tick t <= deadline / generated; TT&C p95 latency over delivered TT&C items; energy per delivered bit as sim/metrics.py attributes it (each item is charged its transmit-time slice of the draw at delivery) and, for Config A only, total load energy drawn over the run (what the battery pays), both under decision 0009's transmit-class power mapping (sim/power.py), which the lookahead rollout now also uses. CIs: percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, over the 20 evaluation seeds.

Relaxation bound (policy/bound.py): an offline clairvoyant schedule that knows every arrival and link-up tick, keeps only the per-tick link budget, and drops power, safe mode, FSM, priority order and non-preemption. No policy can exceed it. Window bound is exact for that relaxation (Moore-Hodgson); deadline bound is the floored fluid optimum.
